steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ without searching the events list.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the stage settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order dialog opened.
Verify that the dialog exposes the evaluation-duration control.
Verify that 60 Mins is an available evaluation-duration option.
Set the evaluation duration to 60 minutes.
Confirm that the dialog shows the selected 60-minute evaluation duration.
Create the recreated order with the selected evaluation duration.
Verify that creating the order did not produce an application error.
